status_preservation: Inherited statuses remain unchanged; current does not mean complete, stable does not mean universally applicable, draft is non-final, and watch requires future review.
boundary: A source ledger proves bounded source selection and status tracking only. It does not validate GMUT, create participant evidence, establish production identity, confer affected-party or Māori authority, decide law, complete accessibility review, prove exhaustive security, or prove independent-team reproduction.
